description:
Keep nighttime necessities close at hand with the French Country 3 Drawer Nightstand from Old Time Oak. This charming nightstand brings the warmth of French Country design to your nursery while providing practical storage for all your essentials.
Three smooth-gliding drawers with dovetail construction offer organized space for pacifiers, lotions, burp cloths, books, and more. The spacious tabletop is perfect for a lamp, baby monitor, or a framed photo. Crafted from solid wood with a durable finish, this nightstand is built to last through every stage of childhood.
The turned legs and gently curved details echo the classic French Country aesthetic, coordinating perfectly with the full French Country collection. Use it beside the glider for late-night feedings or next to the crib for convenient access. Non-toxic, baby-safe finish throughout.
